A conforming app using a public CDN would be wrongly rejected by the obsolete internal no-network annotation, so the current workbook/skill public-network rule is applied. A hidden image override or credential under environment would invalidate the row; parsed keys, Dockerfile COPY scope and credential-indicator inspection found neither.
